description: TB6612FNG DC motor demo: PWMA = PA0 TIM2 1 kHz, AIN1/AIN2/STBY = PB0/PB1/PB12; cw 25-100 %, short brake, ccw 50/100 %, stop, standby, 400 ms each, USART1 log
expect: 72 MHz; TIM2 PSC 71, ARR 999: 1 kHz PWM on PA0 (AF push-pull), CCR1 = 10 x duty (preloaded); PB0 (AIN1), PB1 (AIN2), PB12 (STBY) push-pull, written with one BSRR store per phase. USART1 PA9/PA10 115200 8N1: 'TB6612 DC motor demo\r\n' then 'cw 25%\r\n'; every 400 ms (HAL_GetTick deadlines, no drift) the next phase: cw 25% / 50% / 75% / 100% (AIN1=1 AIN2=0 STBY=1), short brake (AIN1=AIN2=1, duty 100), ccw 50% / 100% (AIN1=0 AIN2=1), stop (AIN1=AIN2=0), standby (STBY=0, duty 0), then again (3.6 s per cycle). The motor speed follows duty x VM almost linearly (PWM low = short brake).

circuit: PA0, PB0, PB1, PB12: TB6612FNG PWMA / AIN1 / AIN2 / STBY in the full circuit (motor covered by tests/devices/motors-firmware.test.ts); unconnected on this bench
USART1: virtual terminal on PA9 (TX) / PA10 (RX)
